# `event_kind_from_abi`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-ABI">ABI</span> <span class="sdk-kind">fn</span>

Source: **ABI v4 Events** (`src/plugins/abi_events.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Converts one stable ABI numeric tag back into the engine-side event kind.

## Signature

```rust
fn event_kind_from_abi (value : u32) -> Option < PluginEvent >
```
